fizikalna-terapija.title: Physical Therapy
fizikalna-terapija.shortDescription: Pain and swelling don't wait for a clinic appointment. Recovery kit + free protocol for your injury — at home. Our clinic as backup if you need it.
fizikalna-terapija.description: Knee pain after training, chronic back pain, swelling after an injury? The goal is simple: kill the pain, kill the swelling, get you back to full motion — fast, with no resets. Electrotherapy, ultrasound, laser and cryotherapy live in our clinic; the same principle at home comes through the Recovery Starter Kit and a free PDF protocol matched to your specific injury. Start with the free protocol, equip yourself with what actually helps, and if you need a hands-on assessment — come see us at the clinic.
fizikalna-terapija.process: Initial assessment → Treatment plan → Sessions → Progress evaluation

faq.question: How many physical therapy sessions are needed?
faq.answer: The number of sessions depends on the diagnosis. Typically 10-15 sessions are needed for optimal results, but the plan is tailored to individual needs.

faq.question: Is physical therapy painful?
faq.answer: Most treatments are painless or minimally uncomfortable. Our therapists always adjust the intensity to your comfort level.

faq.question: When can I expect improvement?
faq.answer: Many patients notice improvement after 3-5 sessions, but full effects are achieved after completing the treatment cycle.

manuelna-terapija.title: Manual Therapy
manuelna-terapija.shortDescription: Stiff back, neck or shoulders? Release most of it at home — with the same tools and protocol our therapists use.
manuelna-terapija.description: Manual mobilization and manipulation work — but you don't need a session every week to feel it. The Recovery Starter Kit (foam roller, lacrosse ball, massage stick) plus a free PDF protocol for self-mobilizing the neck, back and shoulders gets you ~80% of the in-clinic effect at home. For stubborn blockages and complex cases — book a hands-on session at our clinic.
manuelna-terapija.process: Functional assessment → Diagnosis → Manual treatment → Home exercises

faq.question: Is manual therapy safe?
faq.answer: Yes, manual therapy is completely safe when performed by a qualified therapist. We use proven techniques adapted to your condition.

faq.question: Who can benefit from manual therapy?
faq.answer: Manual therapy is effective for anyone with back, neck, or joint pain, or mobility issues.

faq.question: How long does the effect of one session last?
faq.answer: The effect of a single session can last several days to a week. A series of sessions provides longer-lasting results.

kineziterapija.title: Kinesitherapy
kineziterapija.shortDescription: Get moving with a proven progressive exercise program — free PDF + gear that fits in a corner of your room.
kineziterapija.description: Movement heals. But random YouTube exercises lead to plateaus or new injuries. We give you a structured progressive program for your injury: a set of resistance bands + foam roller + free PDF with a weekly plan and video demos. You train at home, we track progress. If progress stalls — book an assessment at our clinic.
kineziterapija.process: Functional status assessment → Individual program → Guided exercises → Progression

faq.question: Can I do the exercises at home too?
faq.answer: Yes, part of the kinesitherapy program includes home exercises that your therapist will explain and demonstrate in detail.

faq.question: How often should I attend kinesitherapy?
faq.answer: We recommend 2-3 times per week for optimal results, but frequency is adjusted to your condition and progress.

faq.question: Is kinesitherapy suitable for older adults?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Programs are adapted to age and fitness level. Kinesitherapy is extremely beneficial for maintaining mobility in older adults.

dijagnostika.title: Diagnostics
dijagnostika.shortDescription: Before you spend months and money on the wrong treatment — find out exactly what's going on.
dijagnostika.description: The biggest cost in recovery isn't therapy — it's the wrong diagnosis. Before you buy anything, run our free Recovery Estimator and the self-assessment PDF. If the result suggests a complex injury, come to our clinic for a detailed exam — history, functional tests, a clear written plan. No guessing, no wasted spend.
dijagnostika.process: Medical history → Clinical exam → Functional testing → Report and plan

faq.question: What does sports medicine diagnostics include?
faq.answer: Diagnostics includes detailed medical history, clinical examination, functional testing, and additional diagnostic methods as needed for precise assessment.

faq.question: Do I need a referral for diagnostics?
faq.answer: No, you can come directly without a referral. We recommend bringing any previous medical documentation you may have.

faq.question: How long does the diagnostic exam take?
faq.answer: A complete diagnostic assessment takes 60-90 minutes, depending on the complexity of the case and tests required.

sportska-rehabilitacija.title: Sports Rehabilitation
sportska-rehabilitacija.shortDescription: From injury to first match — a complete return-to-play protocol, kit, and clinical support when you need it.
sportska-rehabilitacija.description: Returning to sport doesn't just mean 'no pain'. It means 100% strength with zero fear of re-injury. Our return-to-play system combines: rehab phases with measurable goals, a Recovery Starter Kit with sport-specific tapes and supports, a free PDF protocol for your sport, plus clinical support when hands-on work is needed. Fewer setbacks, faster comeback.
sportska-rehabilitacija.process: Injury evaluation → Recovery phase → Functional training → Return-to-play protocol

faq.question: How long does sports injury rehabilitation take?
faq.answer: Duration depends on the type and severity of injury. Minor injuries require 4-6 weeks, while major injuries (e.g., ACL) may require 6-12 months for full recovery.

faq.question: When can I return to training?
faq.answer: Return to training is determined based on a return-to-play protocol. Our team monitors your progress and gives the green light only when you're physically ready.

faq.question: Do you cover all types of sports injuries?
faq.answer: Yes, we work with all types of sports injuries — from muscle strains and ligament injuries to post-operative rehabilitation.

masaza.title: Massage
masaza.shortDescription: After training or a brutal week — release tight muscles yourself, with the same tools our therapists use.
masaza.description: Sports massage works — but you can't book one every day. The Recovery Starter Kit (foam roller, massage stick, vibrating roller) plus a free PDF for self-myofascial release gets you ~80% of the sports-massage effect, at home, whenever you need it. For chronic blockages and competition prep, book a session with us at the clinic.
masaza.process: Consultation → Technique selection → Treatment → Maintenance advice

faq.question: What is the difference between sports and therapeutic massage?
faq.answer: Sports massage focuses on muscle groups active in sports using more intense techniques, while therapeutic massage treats specific pain conditions with gentler approaches.

faq.question: How often should I get a massage?
faq.answer: For athletes we recommend 1-2 times per week. For general maintenance, once every 2-4 weeks is sufficient.

faq.question: Is any preparation needed before a massage?
faq.answer: We recommend coming hydrated and not eating a large meal immediately before treatment. Comfortable clothing is preferred.

recovery-terapije.title: Recovery Therapies
recovery-terapije.shortDescription: Cryo, compression, magnesium, real sleep. Boxed up as a kit + protocol.
recovery-terapije.description: Fast recovery isn't magic — it's a system. Our specialists use cryotherapy, compression boots and advanced modalities in clinic. In your kit we pack what actually works at home: cooling gel pack, compression sleeves, magnesium, sleep stack — plus a free '24-hour Recovery Protocol' PDF. Pro-level results without a pro-level budget.
recovery-terapije.process: Needs assessment → Modality selection → Treatment → Recovery protocol

faq.question: What is cryotherapy and is it safe?
faq.answer: Cryotherapy uses controlled cooling to reduce inflammation and accelerate recovery. It is completely safe under the supervision of our specialists.

faq.question: Can I combine multiple recovery methods?
faq.answer: Yes, we often combine methods for optimal results. For example, cryotherapy after training and compression therapy for muscle recovery.

faq.question: Do recovery therapies help recreational athletes too?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Recovery therapies are beneficial for anyone seeking faster recovery, whether you're a professional athlete or recreational exerciser.

testiranje-merenja.title: Testing & Measurements
testiranje-merenja.shortDescription: Pre-season, post-injury, or just to know where you stand — functional assessment, plan, and the exact gear list you need.
testiranje-merenja.description: Without measurement you train blind. We run FMS, strength, power and biomechanics testing and give you a clear written report — so you know exactly which kit and which protocol to take next. Guides and gear adapt to your results, so you only spend on what actually helps.
testiranje-merenja.process: Testing protocol → Measurements → Results analysis → Training recommendations

faq.question: What is tested during functional testing?
faq.answer: We test strength, endurance, mobility, balance, movement biomechanics, and sport-specific abilities relevant to your sport.

faq.question: How often should testing be repeated?
faq.answer: We recommend testing every 3-6 months to track progress, or before and after a training period/season.

faq.question: Can testing prevent injuries?
faq.answer: Yes, functional testing identifies muscle imbalances and weaknesses that can lead to injuries, enabling preventive work.

cupping-terapija.title: Cupping Therapy
cupping-terapija.shortDescription: Stuck fascia and chronic tension in your back and shoulders? Cupping unlocks the tissue — we also give you a home set with a video protocol.
cupping-terapija.description: Cupping (vacuum therapy) lifts the fascia, opens circulation and breaks down knots that massage alone struggles to reach. In the clinic we use both static and dynamic cupping; for home use we ship a silicone set + a free PDF and video with protocols for back, neck and quads. Less inflammation, more range — without waiting for an appointment.
cupping-terapija.process: Tissue assessment → Cup placement → Static or dynamic work → Home-use plan

faq.question: Does cupping leave bruises?
faq.answer: The reddish marks are normal and fade in 3-7 days. They show stagnant circulation responding — not a true bruise.

faq.question: How often should I do cupping?
faq.answer: For chronic issues 1-2x weekly for 4 weeks; for maintenance 1-2x per month or as part of a weekly home routine.

faq.question: Can I use the home set on myself?
faq.answer: Yes — the silicone cupping set is safe and easy to use. The PDF protocol and video show zones, sequence and timing for each issue.

flossing-terapija.title: Flossing Therapy
flossing-terapija.shortDescription: Stiff ankle, knee or elbow that won't loosen up after training? A flossing band restores range of motion in minutes — home use with a video protocol.
flossing-terapija.description: Flossing uses a heavy elastic band to compress a joint while you move it actively — freeing the fascia, flushing the tissue and instantly expanding range of motion. In the clinic we apply it to specific joints; the kit ships with a band + a free PDF/video covering protocols for the ankle, knee, elbow and shoulder. A solution that works after 5 minutes, not 5 sessions.
flossing-terapija.process: Joint assessment → Band application → Active movement under compression → Range re-test

faq.question: Is flossing painful?
faq.answer: The pressure is intense but short (1-2 minutes max). Any numbness and the band comes off immediately — safe and controlled.

faq.question: Which injuries respond best?
faq.answer: Best results: post-sprain ankle stiffness, chronic tennis elbow, limited shoulder range, post-surgical knee stiffness.

faq.question: Is flossing alone enough?
faq.answer: Flossing opens a window; you then need to use that mobility with exercise. The PDF protocol always pairs flossing with 2-3 follow-up drills.

kinesiotape.title: Kinesiotape
kinesiotape.shortDescription: Knee, shoulder or back pain pulling you off training? Kinesiotape gives stability and reduces pain without limiting movement.
kinesiotape.description: Kinesiotape (elastic therapeutic tape) lifts the skin, opens lymph flow and gives proprioceptive input to a muscle that's overworked or injured. In the clinic a therapist tapes by diagnosis; the kit ships with a pro-grade roll + a free PDF and video covering 12 of the most common applications (knee, shoulder, back, achilles, elbow). Stability you wear for 3-5 days — no pills required.
kinesiotape.process: Pain area assessment → Technique selection (muscle / ligament / lymph) → Application → Care instructions

faq.question: How long does one application last?
faq.answer: 3-5 days. You can shower and train in it — the tape is waterproof.

faq.question: Can I tape myself?
faq.answer: For simple zones (knee, achilles, lower back) — yes, the protocol video walks you through step-by-step. For shoulders and complex applications a therapist is better.

faq.question: Does the tape heal the injury?
faq.answer: No. The tape reduces pain and supports tissue while it heals — which is why it's always part of a wider protocol (exercise + recovery).

presoterapija.title: Pressotherapy
presoterapija.shortDescription: Heavy legs after a long day or hard training? Compression boots do in 30 minutes what would otherwise take a full rest day.
presoterapija.description: Pressotherapy (compression boots) uses sequential pressure to flush the venous and lymphatic system in your legs — the same principle the NBA and Tour de France use for post-training recovery. In the clinic we run a pro device with 4 pressure zones; for home use the shop offers a recovery stack: compression sleeves + magnesium + a free "24h recovery" PDF protocol. Less leg soreness, faster return to training.
presoterapija.process: Recovery assessment → Boot setup → Sequential compression cycle → Home recovery routine plan

faq.question: How often should I do pressotherapy?
faq.answer: For athletes 2-3x weekly during heavy season; for recreational users 1x weekly or after particularly tough sessions.

faq.question: Is the treatment comfortable?
faq.answer: Very — most people fall asleep during the cycle. Strong enough to do the job, gentle enough to relax.

faq.question: Who shouldn't use pressotherapy?
faq.answer: People with deep vein thrombosis, severe heart failure or acute leg infections — always check with a specialist first.

tretman-masaznim-pistoljem.title: Massage Gun Treatment
tretman-masaznim-pistoljem.shortDescription: Tight muscles after training or long desk hours? A massage gun unlocks knots in 5 minutes — we write the protocol, you use it at home every day.
tretman-masaznim-pistoljem.description: Percussive therapy (Theragun-style) breaks up myofascial adhesions, drives circulation and clears DOMS faster than classic massage. In the clinic a therapist knows where, how hard and how long — that's the whole game. In the shop you get a proven gun with attachments + a free PDF/video protocol per muscle group (quads, back, calves, shoulders). A pro-level recovery tool that doesn't require driving to a massage.
tretman-masaznim-pistoljem.process: Map tight zones → Pick attachment + intensity → Treat by protocol → Home-use plan

faq.question: Can I use a massage gun on myself?
faq.answer: Yes — with a protocol. Rule: never directly on bony prominences, nerves or the inner thigh. The PDF shows safe zones and timing.

faq.question: How long per muscle group?
faq.answer: 60-90 seconds per group. More doesn't give more — it just irritates the tissue.

faq.question: Before or after training?
faq.answer: Before training: 30 seconds per group for activation. After training: 60-90 seconds for recovery. Never on a painful, acutely injured area.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A sports-medicine team that built a recovery brand

story.title: Our Story
story.description: We're sports-medicine specialists with years of experience. For years we watched patients walk out the door with advice but no tools. So we built the kit. And the protocol. And the shop. Now any athlete in Serbia can use what our patients use — no waiting, no trip to the clinic.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Every person with an injury should get the right gear and a clear protocol — immediately. No guessing, no wasted purchases, no lost time.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: Sport Care Med as the first place an athlete in Serbia goes when something goes wrong — before AliExpress, before the pharmacy, before Google.

founder.name: Đorđe Ignjatović
founder.bio: Sport Care & Med was built with one job — connect proven sports-medicine products, real expertise and practical application across athletes, clubs and national teams. Đorđe Ignjatović is the founder and the person translating top-level sport know-how into the products and protocols you use. For twenty years he has led the rehabilitation team at OTP Pick Szeged handball club in Hungary — one of the most successful clubs in the region — with experience working with elite athletes, club systems and national teams. Everything that enters our shop and every protocol we publish has to pass one filter: would he hand it to his own athlete before a game? If not — it's not for you.

klupski-recovery-kit.title: Club Recovery Kit
klupski-recovery-kit.shortDescription: Foam roller, massage gun, ice packs and cryo gel — everything the team needs after training, in one box per player.
klupski-recovery-kit.description: After a hard session or match players do recovery — or they should. We pack the kit per player: foam roller, mini massage gun with attachments, two reusable ice packs, cryo gel spray and a short 10-minute routine guide. The club orders for the entire roster in one PO, we ship pre-packed and labeled. Bulk price drops up to 30% below retail, and the player actually knows what to use and how.

faq.question: Can we get a sample before a large order?
faq.answer: Yes. We ship one full kit as a sample for testing before confirming a 25+ unit order.

faq.question: Can we change the kit contents?
faq.answer: You can add or skip individual items. The price adjusts transparently per item.

faq.question: How do you invoice?
faq.answer: One invoice to the club, with a delivery note per player name. Net-30 payment after delivery.

taping-bandaging-paket.title: Taping & Bandaging Kit
taping-bandaging-paket.shortDescription: Kinesio tape, rigid tape, pre-wrap, scissors — what a therapist burns through in a season, in bulk pricing.
taping-bandaging-paket.description: Tape and bandages are consumables — the club always runs out, the therapist buys them piecemeal at pharmacies, and the price doubles. Our bulk pack covers a whole half-season: kinesio tape in 4 colors, rigid sports tape, pre-wrap rolls, sport scissors and adhesive spray. All in one box per therapist or facility.

faq.question: Which brands do you use?
faq.answer: We work with proven European sports-tape manufacturers. The specific brand depends on availability — we confirm with each pack.

faq.question: Can we order kinesio tape only?
faq.answer: Yes, every item can be ordered individually in bulk quantities. The price is still better than individual retail.

faq.question: Do you offer custom colors or club logos?
faq.answer: Logo on packaging — yes. Custom tape colors — possible for orders of 50+ rolls, contact us for details.

prva-pomoc-paket.title: On-Field First-Aid Kit
prva-pomoc-paket.shortDescription: Sprays, cold packs, bandages, splints — a first-aid bag packed to sports-federation standards.
prva-pomoc-paket.description: Every federation rule: every training session and match must have a fully stocked first-aid bag. We pack the bag to protocol, label the contents, list expiry dates and a refill checklist. The club no longer has to track what's missing — once a year we ship a refill, replacing what was used.

faq.question: Does the bag meet football federation requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. Contents align with standard first-aid equipment lists from FSS and regional federations.

faq.question: What if something expires mid-season?
faq.answer: We ship individual replacements on request, or do an annual lump-sum refill of everything used or expired.

faq.question: Do we get training on how to use it?
faq.answer: Each bag comes with a short guide and contents list. For a full first-aid course we have a separate module — contact us for details.

suplementi-paket.title: Club Supplements Kit
suplementi-paket.shortDescription: Magnesium, electrolytes, recovery shakes, protein — tested and free of WADA-listed substances.
suplementi-paket.description: Team supplements are a minefield: too many brands, too many promises, risk of banned substances. We work with proven European manufacturers carrying Informed Sport / Cologne List certification. The kit is packed per player for a full month — magnesium for night recovery, electrolytes for training, recovery shake for post-match, optional protein.

faq.question: Do you have proof of composition and certificates?
faq.answer: Every product comes with a lab analysis and Informed Sport or Cologne List certification. We send these on request.

faq.question: Can we customize the kit contents?
faq.answer: Yes. You can drop the protein, add creatine, adjust the vitamin profile. The price adjusts transparently.

faq.question: Monthly or seasonal payment?
faq.answer: Both. Monthly subscription with no commitment, or a seasonal contract with an extra 5% discount.

oprema-za-zagrevanje.title: Warm-Up & Mobility Kit
oprema-za-zagrevanje.shortDescription: Mini bands, resistance bands, mobility balls — what an S&C coach uses for the pre-training routine.
oprema-za-zagrevanje.description: FIFA 11+, dynamic warm-up, prevention — all of it requires equipment the club has to keep on hand. Our kit packs everything needed for group work with 25 players: mini bands in 3 resistance levels, long resistance bands, lacrosse balls for mobility, balance pads. Durable equipment, bought once for several seasons.

faq.question: Does the kit cover the FIFA 11+ protocol?
faq.answer: Yes. All equipment is selected to cover every FIFA 11+ exercise, plus extra mobility work.

faq.question: We have fewer than 25 players — is the kit worth it?
faq.answer: Yes — the equipment is durable and stays with the club. For smaller groups we can adapt the pack (fewer pieces, lower price).

faq.question: Do you offer coach training?
faq.answer: The kit comes with a PDF guide. For a full FIFA 11+ coach seminar we have a separate module — contact us for details.

timska-rehabilitacija.title: Team Rehabilitation
timska-rehabilitacija.shortDescription: Kit + protocol + clinical coordination for every injured player — no wandering from one therapist to another.
timska-rehabilitacija.description: A player gets injured — and the circus starts: which therapist, which pharmacy, what to take home. We cut that. Every injured player immediately gets their kit (rehab gear + PDF protocol), we coordinate with your coach and S&C staff, and when hands-on work is needed — a therapist from our team comes to your facility or the player comes to our clinic. faq.question: How many players can be included in the program?
faq.answer: The program is scalable for teams of 15 to 50+ members. Pricing is adjusted based on team size.

faq.question: Do therapists come to the club or do players come to you?
faq.answer: We combine both approaches. Rehabilitation takes place at our center, but for acute cases and monitoring we can come to your facility.

faq.question: How does coordination with coaching staff work?
faq.answer: Regular weekly reports, joint meetings, and direct communication with coaches and fitness trainers.

fizioterapija-na-terenu.title: On-Site Physiotherapy
fizioterapija-na-terenu.shortDescription: Therapist + a full bag of kits at every training session and match.
fizioterapija-na-terenu.description: Acute on-pitch injury, taping, fast intervention, pre-training prevention — all on site. Our therapist comes with a full bag (tapes, supports, cooling gel, portable ultrasound) and stays for warm-up and cool-down. No panic when someone goes down, no waiting for appointments, no wasted player time.
fizioterapija-na-terenu.process: Schedule coordination → Therapist on location → Intervention as needed → Post-session report → Treatment recommendations

faq.question: How many training sessions per week do you cover?
faq.answer: We adapt to your schedule. Standard packages cover 3-5 training sessions per week plus matches.

faq.question: What equipment does the on-site therapist bring?
faq.answer: A complete therapeutic bag: tapes, bandages, ice, portable ultrasound, electrostimulation, and a first aid kit.

faq.question: Is the therapist present only during training?
faq.answer: The therapist arrives 30 minutes before training (for warm-up and prevention) and stays 15-30 minutes after to handle any injuries.

prevencija-povreda.title: Injury Prevention Programs
prevencija-povreda.shortDescription: FIFA 11+ + a bulk prevention kit for the whole team + start-of-season screening.
prevencija-povreda.description: The cheapest injury is the one that never happened. At the start of the season we screen every player, flag the high-risk ones, give each player a personal prevention kit (tapes, foam roller, supports) and a free PDF protocol matched to the sport. Clubs that did this saw 50% fewer injuries in the first season — the numbers are there.
includes: Screening of all players at season start
prevencija-povreda.process: Team screening → Risk analysis → Individual programs → Implementation → Monthly evaluation → Program correction

faq.question: How long does the initial screening take?
faq.answer: For a team of 25 players, the complete screening takes 1-2 days. It includes FMS, strength tests, flexibility, and previous injury assessment.

faq.question: Does the program include training for coaches?
faq.answer: Yes. We educate the coaching staff on risk signs, proper warm-up, and implementation of preventive exercises into daily training.

faq.question: How does prevention cost compare to treatment?
faq.answer: Our experience shows that every dollar invested in prevention saves 5 dollars in treatment and rehabilitation costs. Plus, players miss fewer training sessions and matches.

testiranje-performansi.title: Team Performance Testing
testiranje-performansi.shortDescription: FMS, strength, power — the whole roster in one day, you get a plan and tailored kits.
testiranje-performansi.description: Without data you train blind. We test 25+ players in one day: FMS, vertical jump, sprint, isokinetic tests, biomechanics. Each athlete gets an individual report, the coach gets a risk matrix and a plan, the club gets an offer of tailored kits for the weaknesses we found. Re-test in 3-6 months — progress shows up in black and white.
testiranje-performansi.process: Schedule appointment → Team testing (1-2 days) → Data analysis → Individual reports → Coach presentation → Retesting after 3-6 months

faq.question: What tests are included in the battery?
faq.answer: FMS, vertical jump, 10m/30m sprint, Yo-Yo test, isokinetic tests, movement analysis, flexibility, and sport-specific tests.

faq.question: Can testing be done at our facility?
faq.answer: Most tests are portable and can be done in your gym or on the field. For specialized lab tests, we invite you to our center.

faq.question: How often should testing be repeated?
faq.answer: We recommend testing 2-3 times per year: pre-season, mid-season, and post-season. This gives a picture of progress and training effects.

faq.question: How accurate is this recovery estimate?
faq.answer: This estimate is based on average recovery times from medical literature. Actual recovery time may vary depending on many factors. For an accurate assessment, we recommend a professional examination.

faq.question: What factors affect recovery speed?
faq.answer: Key factors include: injury severity, age, overall health, pre-injury fitness level, quality of rehabilitation, and adherence to the recovery plan.

faq.question: Can I speed up my recovery?
faq.answer: Yes, regular and professionally guided rehabilitation, proper nutrition, adequate rest, and gradual activity increase can significantly speed up recovery.

faq.question: When is the right time to return to sport after injury?
faq.answer: The right time to return depends on many factors, including injury type, quality of rehabilitation and individual response to recovery. This checklist helps you objectively assess your readiness.

faq.question: What if I'm not ready according to the checklist?
faq.answer: If the checklist shows you're not fully ready, that's not a cause for concern. Focus on the weakest areas and continue rehabilitation. Returning to sport too early can lead to re-injury.

faq.question: Does this checklist replace a medical assessment?
faq.answer: No. This checklist is a self-assessment tool and does not replace a professional medical examination. We recommend sharing your results with your doctor or physiotherapist.
